name: Performance Review Commission
notes: The PRC is an independent body of seven experts reporting to the EUROCONTROL Permanent Commission, supported by the Performance Review Unit (PRU); its pages on eurocontrol.int (air-navigation-services-performance-review) use the EUROCONTROL identity. Not to be confused with the SES Performance Review Body. The PRU's Aviation Intelligence Portal (ansperformance.eu, developed by the EUROCONTROL Aviation Intelligence Unit) was checked on 2026-11-09 (home, /about/prc/, /about/us/, /about/aiu/, /about/disclaimer/): its header carries only the EUROCONTROL standard logo (/images/header/EUROCONTROL-logo-standard-rgb.svg) and the remaining images are photos, banners, app-store badges and QR codes, with no PRC or PRU logo and no brand or downloads page. ansperformance.eu is therefore not added to official_domains, because no asset is taken from it.
